scope: Frozen postprocessing only; all fixed test cases included, no threshold/error-based test selection, refitting or clipping.
roi_definition: Exact nonzero final-time FEM EPSP support union over all fixed test cases; reference XY bounding rectangle plus 1 mm display-only margin. Margin is not an accuracy or success threshold.
overlap_policy: At coincident reference XY, higher absolute scalar values are drawn last to expose localized fields; this is not a 3D deformed-surface view.
